name: docs_tutorials_13
source:
{ Series RLC low-pass filter -- Tutorial 3 }
R = 220 [ohm]
L = 0.1 [H]
C = 1e-6 [F]

w0 = 1 / sqrt(L * C)
Q  = w0 * L / R

f  = 200 [Hz]
w  = 2 * pi# * f
X_L = w * L
X_C = 1 / (w * C)
Z_mag = sqrt(R^2 + (X_L - X_C)^2)
phi   = arctan((X_L - X_C) / R)
V_s   = 5 [V]
I_mag = V_s / Z_mag
V_out = I_mag * X_C
gain  = V_out / V_s

num = [1]
den = [L * C, R * C, 1]
omega[1:400] = linspace(100, 30000, 400)
CALL bode(num, den, omega : mag, phase)

PLOT 'RLC Low-Pass Bode'
  kind = bode
  omega = omega
  mag = mag
  phase = phase
END
